item.title: Benchmarking RAG: Designing a solution that tells you why
item.description: When I first started building RAG demos, I mostly evaluated them the same way many of us probably do: ask a question, read the answer, and decide whether it looks right. That works…​but it is manual, subjective, and time-intensive. A pipeline might give a great answer to the question you happened to try, then give a poor one on a related question, miss relevant context, or confidently make up a detail.
